name: Expedia Group

SDE I.dsaDepth: Moderate - an online assessment (2 string/substring problems, 75 min) then a 3-round onsite mixing behavioral, OOP design, and coding
rounds: Online assessment: 2 coding questions (string manipulation/substrings), 75 minutes
Round 1 - Behavioral: background and motivation, often with a junior engineer
Round 2 - Data structures and OOP design: a design-flavored coding problem (e.g. hotel-bookings max-occupancy)
Round 3 - "Problem solving" (actually coding): a further LeetCode-style problem
extraTopics: LeetCode-easy-to-medium pattern recognition (Valid Parentheses, anagrams, palindrome variants are commonly reported) - the bar rewards speed and clarity over obscure algorithms
OOP design thinking applied to a travel-domain problem (bookings, hotels)

SDE II / Senior.dsaDepth: Moderate - 2 coding rounds plus a discussion-based system design round and a behavioral/hiring-manager conversation
rounds: Onsite: 2 medium-difficulty coding rounds, 1 discussion-based system design round (e.g. a notification service, with many follow-up questions rather than one deep prompt), 1 hiring-manager/behavioral round
extraTopics: Discussion-based system design - interviewers keep extending follow-ups rather than staying on a single narrow prompt
Clear articulation of technical decisions and trade-offs
